column1: Finally, a word about how monetary and fiscal policy influences the demand for goods and services. Monetary policymakers affect demand by changing the real interest rate rt . Thus, their actions work through the second term in this equation. By contrast, when fiscal policymakers alter taxes or government spending, they change demand for any given interest rate. As a result, the variable et captures changes in fiscal policy. An increase in government spending or a tax cut that stimulates consumer spending means a positive value of et . A cut in government spending or a tax hike means a negative value of et . As we will see, one purpose of this model is to examine the dynamic effects of changes in monetary and fiscal policy.
